summary: I sent the bounded brief with no visual cues. The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, said it was bounded and would keep the design in chat, and read NOTES.md, the page files and the four UI guidelines. An auto-compaction happened during that reading, and the skills were restored afterwards. It then asked two non-visual questions in the terminal (which filters, and the no-JS gap). After that it ran scripts/start-server.sh on its own and gave a localhost URL with a key. It wrote filter-placement.html with three layouts (A: panel above the table, B: popover with tags, C: sidebar) and asked me to choose in the terminal. I picked A. It then wrote out the design in chat, asked for my yes, and after I approved it said "Starting the implementation." No spec or plan file was created, and no writing-plans skill was loaded.
reasoning: I checked all eight criteria against the session log and the files on disk. The agent worked out on its own that the layout question was visual and opened the companion only when that question came up. It kept the non-visual questions in the terminal and kept the bounded path with no spec or plan. It asked for approval before writing code and started implementing after I approved. The auto-compaction during the reading phase didn't stop any of this.

observations.description: On the first-run workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the cursor starts on "No, exit". That's safe, but it's easy to quit by accident when just pressing Enter through the setup.

The startup dialog said "Currently pinned: Opus 5 / Latest available: Opus 5.5" even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I answered No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5. The pinned-model message looks inconsistent with that.
The companion writes to .hyperpowers/ at the repo root, which isn't in .gitignore, so git status shows it as untracked. The agent pointed this out itself, but the skill could handle it.

The agent warned that "The sketches use quite a lot of tokens". Once the companion was open, context dropped to about 13% and then 7% until auto-compact. The session log has several compaction boundaries, including one during the guideline reading. The flow still made it through each compaction (skills restored), but the context headroom is tight.

After I picked a layout in the companion, the agent asked for a second, separate approval of the full written design, and also raised the missing-token-sheet question. That's reasonable, but it adds a round trip on the bounded path.

Once the agent's question menu was open, my only way to give a free-text answer was the 'Type something' option (choosing a numbered option didn't fit my answer). That worked, but it took arrow-key navigation.

criteria.evidence: The first tool call in the session log is `Skill: hyperpowers:brainstorming`. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) Successfully loaded skill" right after the brief.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen with candidate layouts written
criteria.evidence: Bash in the log: `.../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir "$PWD" --open`. The screen showed "http://localhost:56841/?key=36bce6...". A Write created .hyperpowers/brainstorm/16185-1793835513/content/filter-placement.html, which has the h3 headings "Filter panel above the table, always open", "\"Filter\" button with a popover..." and "Sidebar to the left of the table".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: reads → two AskUserQuestion calls in the terminal ("Which ways should people be able to narrow..." and the "No-JS gap" question) → start-server.sh → Write filter-placement.html. The companion was not mentioned or started before the layout question came up.

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held; companion did not escalate ceremony
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Since this is a bounded change (adding a filter to the existing activity page), I'll share a quick design in chat rather than a full spec." The design was later written out in chat.

`find coding-agent-workdir ... -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. The only Write targets in the log are filter-placement.html and waiting.html under .hyperpowers/brainstorm.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: Listing Skill tool_use calls in the log gives only `hyperpowers:brainstorming` and `hyperpowers:communication`. No plan file exists on disk (same find returned nothing).

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Tell me which one you prefer here in the terminal." After my pick it wrote out the design and said "To go ahead I need your yes on this design". git status showed only `?? .hyperpowers/`, with no edits to public/ before I approved.

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: Screen after my approval: "Starting the implementation. First I'm pulling the exact token values from guideline 01."
